newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron says small impact from blast.
newsitem.headline: Petron says small impact from blast.

text.p: The Philippines' largest oil refiner Petron Corp said on Tuesday the only effect of a blast at its refinery near Manila last week was the shutting down of a thermal cracker unit.

"On June 20, a small steam-producing pressure vessel (catalyst cooler) exploded in the thermofor catalytic cracker unit (TCCU) at Petron Bataan Refinery," the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
"Only the TCCU is shut down. The refinery of Petron is still running at maximum capacity of 155,000 barrels per day of crude."
The company said there would be a slight cut in the production of liquified petroleum gas, gasoline and diesel.
But the supply of these products would not be affected.
"The refinery has sufficient inventory and supply arrangements until the TCCU will be back on stream," it said.
